description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.4-baseline.3 and mvp-0.4-baseline.4, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.from: Reconciliation step 1: I's revocation of (OWNER, PAIR_J), reason 3 propagated as 0
changed.to: DEVICE_REVOKE {OWNER, PAIR_J, 0} in X, where the pairing device PAIR_J is not bound: accepted, an unbound tombstone of OWNER; IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §7.1 step 1 does not propose it (mvp-0.4-baseline.4): a pairing device is never bound outside I
changed.rule: LFCP-04-415, finding 1 (P1), IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §7.1 step 1 (mvp-0.4-baseline.4): reconciliation propagates a revoked pair of I into X only when it is relevant there. A pairing device is never bound outside I (W §7.3 c3, c6; N8), so the consume or cancellation of a pairing session is no longer propagated; it used to take one of the 64 unbound revoked pairs of W §17.5 rule 5 in every X, after which the revocation of a personal device not yet registered in X could no longer be recorded. The cases that revoked PAIR_J in X keep their bytes and verdicts; their description and rule now state the wire decision and that IP §7.1 no longer proposes them.
